notes: Per-actor movement and work rates. walk_ref_speed is the art's reference px/s: walk speed_scale = actual velocity / walk_ref_speed. move_speed_mult scales GameState.get_move_speed(), which already includes Keeper's Stride. work_rate scales harvest output, watering rewards, and Forge station speed. reliquary_work_rate replaces work_rate at the Reliquary.

corvane.notes: Phase 0 companion. Portrait and selection only. No Forge tending and no adventure slot.
